title: AEGIS Canon Stratification Contract
description: Separates Canon-as-identity from Canon-as-reference (The Way, 'Canon-as-identity vs Canon-as-reference'). Stratifying Canon prevents two shortfalls at once: identity-confabulation (Foundation retrieved and able to fall short) and identity-bloat (every canonical detail injected always-present). Canon-as-identity is Foundation, always present, never retrieval-scored and never retired. Canon-as-reference (definitions, procedures, pipeline order, exact wording, specs) is evidence, retrieved and cited, never injected always-present.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this canon-stratification record.

canon_identity_refs.description: The Foundation Canon Core: Canon-as-identity, always present as the peer's active 'I'. These are what the peer interprets FROM, not what it retrieves. They are NEVER retrieval-scored and NEVER retired. Covers the always-present Foundation-core: nature, core axioms, dignity, consent, civility, non-force, illumination, no-penalties, stewardship, record-truth. Each entry references a Foundation-core element; the peer should never have to go looking for who it is.

items.description: A reference to one always-present Foundation-core element (e.g. nature, a core axiom, dignity, consent, civility, non-force, illumination, no-penalties, stewardship, record-truth).

canon_reference_policy.description: Policy governing Canon-as-reference: definitions, procedures, pipeline order, exact wording, and specs. This material is retrievable and cited when needed, and is NEVER injected always-present. It is evidence read FROM the Locus, never confused with Canon-as-identity.

retrievable.description: Will be true. Canon-as-reference is summoned/retrieved when needed.

always_present.description: Will be false. Canon-as-reference is never injected always-present; injecting it always-present is identity-bloat.

citation_required.description: Will be true. Canon-as-reference, when used, is cited to its source record; it is evidence, not identity.

reference_classes.description: The classes of material that are Canon-as-reference (retrieved and cited, never always-present): definitions, procedures, pipeline order, exact wording, and specs.

source_refs.description: Optional references locating where Canon-as-reference material is stored for retrieval (deep archive / TurboQuant-retired / reference records).

$comment: Load-bearing discipline: Canon-as-identity (canon_identity_refs) is Foundation -- always present, never retrieval-scored, never retired. Canon-as-reference (canon_reference_policy) is evidence -- retrievable:true, always_present:false, citation_required:true -- and is never injected always-present. Identity is never scored/retired; reference is never made always-present.
